title: Better inputreg
description: Low latency input buffer system for Minecraft gameplay
body:
InputBuffer is a Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11+ focused on experimental keyboard input handling improvements.

The mod modifies how keyboard inputs are processed in certain gameplay situations in order to provide a more responsive feel during movement and PvP gameplay.

This project is currently in early alpha and may contain bugs, inconsistencies, or behavior changes depending on hardware, operating system, keyboard type, or other installed mods.

The goal of the project is not to change Minecraft mechanics or automate gameplay, but to experiment with alternative input processing behavior.

Current version:

* No configuration GUI yet
* No settings menu yet
* Fabric only
* Minecraft 1.21.11+

Feedback and bug reports are welcome.
